verdict.rationale: Groq's docs explicitly describe uploading and running inference with pre-made LoRA adapters on its infrastructure, matching the LoRA-adapter part of the story, but there is no evidence of uploading arbitrary custom full model weights (only 'pre-made' adapters for supported base models) nor any independent/hands-on confirmation of this workflow. Missing for 10: support for uploading full custom model weights (not just LoRA adapters), details on which base models/formats are supported, and independent verification of the LoRA serving feature.
